title: AS Watson implements AI and robotics at 55 distribution centres to accelerate global supply chain
summary: Superdrug and The Perfume Shop-owner AS Watson is turning to artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and automation to accelerate its supply chain transformation across more than 55 distribution centres globally

extraction.key_fact: AS Watson이 전 세계 물류센터에 AI와 로봇을 도입해 공급망 전환을 서두르고 있다.
